title: Module-graph cycle reported as a failed check
code_snippet:
$ go mod graph | head
example.com/a@v1.0.0 example.com/b@v1.1.0
example.com/b@v1.1.0 example.com/a@v1.0.0

# Auditor's report:
# "FAIL — circular dependency between modules a and b. Audit incomplete."
expected_feedback: Module-graph cycles are legal in Go; modules may require each other, and only package-level import cycles are rejected by the compiler. This cannot be a pass/fail item. Report it as a WARN-level design observation: the cycle couples the two modules' release cadences and widens upgrade blast radius.
